name: upstox-bond-sell-no-card
describes: A bond sell at Upstox, which no card prices (W-179 G5): NO_SCHEDULE, Rs 0. The broker's unscoped maintenance card agrees with every dimension of the trade, but it has no rule for a sale, so it is not chosen (W-304); from W-177 to W-304 it stood in and the trade read NO_MATCHING_RULES.
